segs.description: Line segments [x0, y0, x1, y1] (a step graph's steps)

given.description: A graph the paper prints already (drawn under the learner's)

k.description: What the criterion marks: xl / yl an axis' label (with unit); scale both axes' scales among ok; points `min` of `ids` right in x and y; xs / ys every one of `ids` right in x (class midpoints, upper limits) or in y; line the line is one of `kinds` and joins `ids` (all right); shape the line is one of `kinds` (`straight`, over `range`; `through` a point); fit a straight line of best fit through the learner's points (within `tol`); extrap the straight line reaches x = `x` within `tol` of `y` (extrapolated to the axis); tangent the straight line touches the given curve inside `range` within `tol`

name.description: A NEUTRAL name for its result chip ('Shape', 'Starting point'): never the answer

ids.description: The points the test reads (points / xs / ys: default every point with an `at`)

min.description: points: how many of ids must be right ('3 or more coordinates'); fit: how many points at least

part.description: points: [[count, marks]] for fewer right than min (the memo's '1-4 correct: 1')

joined.description: points: the memo's 'plotted AND joined': a line must be drawn too

kinds.description: line / shape: the lines the memo accepts: best a straight line (of best fit), curve a smooth curve through the points, join the points joined by straight lines

range.description: shape: [x0, x1] the criterion speaks of ('the graph from 3 s to 7,5 s'); tangent: the curve's x range

straight.description: shape: true the line is straight over range (the learner's points there lie on one line); false a curve over range (a smooth curve through points that do not)

through.description: shape: [x, y] the line passes through ('through the origin')

tol.description: fit / extrap / tangent: how far off still earns it, in y units

ref.description: tangent: the memo's line, two points [[x, y], [x, y]] (for the record and the self-test; never shown)

tests.description: One per criterion, in the criteria's order: what earns it

anyOf.description: Only for 'Draw a graph of ... / plot the data / draw an ogive / a frequency polygon / a line graph on the grid' the memo marks by its axes, scale, points and line: BUILT on a grid, the learner choosing the labels and scale where the memo marks them, placing each point and choosing the line; or (tangent) drawing a straight line on the graph the paper gives. One test per criterion; a criterion nothing can earn is flagged. The criteria keep the memo's own text

id.description: The tray's force the memo's label means: Fg (w, Fg, FG, Fw, weight, mg, gravitational force), FN (N, FN, normal force), f (f, Ff, fk, fs, friction), FA (F, FA, Fapplied, Fengine, applied force), T (T, FT, TC, TR, Fstring, tension), FE (FE, electrostatic force), Fnet (net force: never acts as a separate force)

at.description: Its direction in degrees, anticlockwise from pointing right (0 right, 90 up, 180 left, 270 down; a slope's normal and friction from the slope's angle: a slope falling to the right at 15°, N 75, friction up it 165)

tol.description: Only where the paper fixes the direction loosely (an angle θ found in a later part; a figure not to scale): how far from at still earns it, in degrees (default: the build's tol)

crit.description: 0-based index of the memo criterion this force earns (one mark: its label AND direction)

forces.description: Every force the memo's diagram draws, in the memo's order; two of one kind (a cable's and a rope's tension) are told apart by direction

tol.description: How far from at a direction still earns, in degrees (default 10)

free.description: Forces the memo lets go unmarked ('do not penalise if vertical forces (w, N) are shown'): neither earn nor cost. Any other force not in forces costs 1 mark

surface.description: The surface the body rests on, as the paper's figure draws it, in degrees (0 level, 30 rising to the right, −15 falling to the right); leave out for a hanging body

body.description: The body's faint outline round the dot (default box on a surface)

pairs.description: Each angle the memo accepts: [line, line, degrees], a line a force id or 'V' (the vertical) or 'H' (the horizontal): ['T', 'V', 20]

angle.description: Only where the question asks to indicate an angle: its criterion and the angles that earn it, between two of the learner's right arrows or an arrow and a guide

anyOf.description: Only for 'Draw a (labelled) free-body diagram / a vector diagram of the forces acting on ...' the memo marks one mark per force (label and arrow) and 'any additional force: deduct 1': BUILT from a dot, the learner aiming each force from the same tray of seven. Each force names its criterion; the angle too where one is asked. Not for a vector SCALE diagram of displacements (lengths and magnitudes marked). The criteria keep the memo's own text
